{{incomplete|needs=Case and disc divisions}} [[File:Kanto and Orange Islands - Limited Edition Collection.png|thumb|Kanto and Orange Islands - Limited Edition Collection]] [[File:Kanto and Orange Islands - Limited Edition Collection angled.png|thumb|Angled cover image]] The '''Pokémon the Series: Kanto and Orange Islands - Limited Edition Collection''' is a Region 4 DVD set released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on March 2, 2016, and in New Zealand on March 16, 2016. This DVD set is also referred to as the '''Pokémon Adventures in Kanto and the Orange Islands Collector's Set''' in promotional material. It contains four individual DVD cases with uniform covers that each contain a number of discs. Overall, the set includes 22 discs with 173 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE6366. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. It contains all of the regular dubbed episodes of {{aniseries|PTS}} that take place in [[Kanto]] or the [[Orange Islands]], with the exceptions of ''[[Holiday Hi-Jynx]]'', ''[[EP090|Stage Fight!]]'', ''[[EP099|The Mandarin Island Miss Match]]'' (which all featured {{p|Jynx}} in its original design), and the "lost episode" ''[[EP018|Beauty and the Beach]]''. It contains episodes from ''[[S01|Indigo League]]'', ''[[S02|Adventures in the Orange Islands]]'', ''[[S03|The Johto Journeys]]'', ''[[S08|Advanced Battle]]'', and ''[[S09|Battle Frontier]]''. In Region 4 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to standard [[season]]s, rather than by [[Viz Media]] season. ==Contents== {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Kanto}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Kanto}}" !
